items.q: Do I need to visit the Rajkot office in person?
items.a: No. Most vehicle insurance, RTO tax, RC transfer, and government form services are handled 100% online via WhatsApp and official portals. For services requiring physical vehicle inspection (such as re-passing or fitness), we coordinate slot booking and full guidance.

items.q: Do you provide services outside Gujarat?
items.a: Yes. Along with all Gujarat RTOs (Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, and others), we assist vehicle owners across all 28 Indian states and 8 Union Territories for insurance, interstate NOCs, and online documentation.

items.q: How do I remove a bank loan (Hypothecation) from my RC Book?
items.a: Simply share your bank NOC and Form 35 (2 copies), RC Book, insurance copy, and Aadhaar on WhatsApp (+91 97732 02255). Our team handles the complete HP cancellation workflow.

items.q: When and how do I make the payment?
items.a: First, share your documents on WhatsApp for verification. Once we confirm the exact government fee and service charge, you can pay securely via UPI or a verified payment link.

items.q: Can an expired car or bike insurance policy be renewed online?
items.a: Yes, expired two-wheeler and car insurance policies can be renewed online the same day with quick digital inspection where needed.

sections.heading: 1. Browser Storage & Preferences
sections.body: Patel Auto Advisors uses browser localStorage strictly to remember your selected website language (Gujarati, English, or Hindi) and display theme (Light/Dark mode). We never store your personal details, phone numbers, vehicle numbers, or document files in browser storage.

sections.heading: 2. WhatsApp Enquiry Transmission
sections.body: Information entered into our enquiry form is formatted locally on your device into a WhatsApp Click-to-Chat message. Details are transmitted only when you manually tap 'Send' inside WhatsApp to +91 97732 02255.

sections.heading: 3. Document Confidentiality
sections.body: Documents shared with our consultancy desk are used exclusively to process your requested insurance or RTO application and are never sold or disclosed to unauthorized third parties.

sections.heading: 1. Scope of Consultancy
sections.body: Patel Auto Advisors provides advisory, documentation preparation, and online filing support for vehicle insurance and RTO services. Final approvals remain subject to respective Regional Transport Office (RTO) and insurer regulations.

sections.heading: 2. Document Authenticity
sections.body: Clients are responsible for ensuring that all submitted documents (RC book, Aadhaar, PUC, bank NOC, etc.) are genuine, accurate, and legally valid.

sections.heading: 3. Fees & Processing Timelines
sections.body: Applicable government fees and consultancy charges are communicated transparently before processing. Timelines may vary depending on RTO server availability and statutory inspection schedules.

sections.heading: Independent Consultancy Practice
sections.body: Patel Auto Advisors is an independent private automobile insurance and RTO documentation consultancy. We are not a government department or an official Parivahan/RTO authority; we assist vehicle owners in completing official applications accurately and lawfully.

sections.heading: Regulatory Updates
sections.body: RTO road taxes, document checklists, and portal procedures are governed by state and central transport authorities and may change without prior notice.
